timing: before DataSTOC response values are fetched or inspected for EOG-WF
reason: The initial contract stated that all calibration positives would become forecast sources, while the merged EOG-WF algorithm distinguishes declared source anchors from additional positive observations used to eliminate incompatible worlds. This amendment resolves that implementation-contract mismatch before outcome access.

supersedes.eligibility_and_preoutcome_contract.json: heldout forecast propagation uses all 2006-2011 calibration-positive sites as realized sources inside each surviving world

final_source_policy.anchor_selection: select up to 10 calibration-positive sites by the already-frozen deterministic farthest-first geographic rule
final_source_policy.calibration_constraints: all other calibration-positive sites are positive compatibility targets; they may eliminate worlds but do not become additional forecast sources
final_source_policy.calibration_forecast_features: compute horizon-8 site support from the fixed anchor set in each surviving calibration-period world operator
final_source_policy.heldout_forecast_features: compute horizon-8 site support from the same fixed anchor set in the corresponding surviving heldout-period world operator
final_source_policy.ecological_interpretation: anchors are a deterministic conditioning subset of realized period-1 positives, not inferred ancestral populations or historical colonization origins

why_not_all_positives_as_sources: Using every calibration positive as a forecast source would collapse the distinction between observations that condition source state and observations that test a world's ability to realize the observed distribution. It would also not match the current EOG-WF inverse-then-forward implementation.
forbidden_after_response_open: promote calibration compatibility targets to forecast sources
choose source sites by heldout prediction performance
reinterpret deterministic anchors as inferred ancestry
